book.name: Macho
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Macho gɛ̀ saŋ

content.text: “Bɛŋ yɛ̂ne lɛ keefɛ bɛŋ doo bɛŋ gee mwɛɛ mù njoŋe, bɛŋ gêe a bamii fwe ki bo yɛ̂ne gɛ. Nɛ bɛŋ gee noo, chiji wene wù le fɛwe gɛ ka wu mâajɛ bɛŋ gɛ.

Noo, sege wo nyaa fiɛɛ muh wù fuude le, keefɛ wo mo wo tôŋe soŋ njɛ bamii ba jɛme yeye bo gee yeye to bo gee yéh yi buunɛ le mo jé le, lɛ bamii shânɛ bo gɛ. Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ bo le bo kɛmɛ wa maajɛ wuboo.
Geenɛ, sege wo nyaa fiɛɛ muh wù fuude le, keefɛ wo gê kibo kuŋ kiŋkoŋo kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì kinchiɛɛŋ gee gɛ.
Noo, nnya yo nyû nyilɛ le, Chijo wù yɛde mwɛɛ mu ba gee nyilɛ le, lé wu gê wu maajɛ wo.

Sege bɛŋ buune, keefɛ bɛŋ gêe njɛ no bamii ba jɛme yeye bo gee yeye to bo gee gɛ. Bo to bo koŋe ki bo lɛme yéh yi buunɛ le, mo ntasɛ yi jé le bo buune, lɛ bamii yɛ̂ne bo le. Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ bo le bo kɛmɛ wa maajɛ wuboo.
Geenɛ sege wo goone ki wo bûunɛ, wo lee wo gɛɛŋ yeh, wo faa kimbuŋ fɛ wo buune fɛ Chijo wù le nyilɛ le. Chijo wù yɛde mwɛɛ mù ba gee nyilɛ le, lé wu mâajɛ wo.
Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ buune, keefɛ bɛŋ shê bɛŋ laane njɛ no bamii ba maa Nyo to bo gee gɛ. Bo gee noo bo kwaji lɛ ba le ba yu buunɛ chiboo nje jɛ́ yì bo jɛme wesee.
Keefɛ bɛŋ nyûme njɛ no bo le gɛ. Bɛŋ kêe lɛ Chiji wene kee wa fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ goone fɛ bɛŋ biide.
Le nɛ no taŋlo bɛŋ bûune: ‘Chiji wese wù le fɛwe, gêe lɛ bamii ŋgvûune jee chuŋ,
wo gê lɛ bvunfoŋ bwuŋ to, wo gê fiɛɛ fì wo goone fɛkuu fɛnɛ fi nyûme no fi le fɛwe.
Nya bee bɛ mwɛɛ munjile mu abɛŋ.
Lɛɛshɛ bimbefɛ biɛsa, no bee tɛ lɛɛshi bimbefɛ bì bamii bamu gee fɛ bee le.
Keefɛ wo chînɛ bee lee moŋ wù ya bee le gɛ. Fi bee chiaaŋ yi muh wu kimbefɛ wɛɛ le.’
[Bvunfoŋ le bwuŋ, bvuŋga nyu bwuŋ, bvukugɛ nyu bwuŋ segechii bvu kage gɛ. Fi nyûme noo.]
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ nɛ bɛŋ lɛɛshi bimbefɛ bi bamii bamu gee fɛ bɛŋ le, Chiji wene wù le fɛwe lɛɛshɛ tɛ biɛna.
Geenɛ, nɛ bɛŋ le njɛ bɛŋ lɛɛshi bimbefɛ bì bamii bamu gee fɛ bɛŋ le sɛŋ, Chiji wene gɛ lɛɛshɛ tɛ biɛna gɛ.

Sege bɛŋ bane mwɛɛ munjile, keefɛ bɛŋ jîiŋe nɛ yulaa njɛ no bamii ba chiaase ye gee gɛ. Bo kusɛ manshi maboo lɛ segeyu, wu lɛ bamii yɛ̂ne lɛ bo banɛ mwɛɛ munjile. Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ bo le bo kɛmɛ wa maajɛ wuboo.
Geenɛ, sege wo banɛ mwɛɛ munjile, wo yefɛ kikwɛɛ kuŋ, wo chugɛ bvushi bwuŋ,
wu lɛ keefɛ bamii yɛ̂ne lɛ wo banɛ mwɛɛ munjile gɛ, le yɛde gɛh Chijo wù le nyilɛ le. Le Chijo wù yɛde mwɛɛ mù bamii gee nyilɛ le wu lé wu gê wu mâajɛ wo.
Keefɛ bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛde nchvu yene fɛkuu fɛnɛ fɛ taŋlo shé kaaŋ, taŋlo tɛ ŋga koo, bachoŋ taŋlo bo ŋgode bo lee bo choŋ gɛ.
Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛde nchvu yene nyu yi woŋ wù Nyo le, fɛ taŋlo shé gɛ kaaŋ gɛ, taŋlo tɛ ŋga gɛ koo gɛ, bachoŋ taŋlo tɛ bo gɛ ŋgode bo lee bo choŋ gɛ.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ fɛ muh gɛɛde nchvu ye fo le fɛ fitele fie le fo.

content: Kin'yesɛ ki ye yi muh le

content.text: Ajii a muh le kin'yesɛ yi ye ye le. Noo, ajii a wo nɛ yuude lo, tu ye yo yichii le yi yisɛ bɛ n'yuu.
Geenɛ, ajii a wo nɛ jime lo, tu ye yo yichii le yi yisɛ bɛ kijibɛ. Nɛ n'yuu wu muh le wu ja wu tu kijibɛ, kijibɛ kiyu jime wa nɛɛ?

content: Nyo jiiŋe fɛ bamii be le

content.text: Gɛ nfwa taŋlo wu lɛ̂ne bachiji kikwɛɛ le bafɛɛ gɛ. Wu nɛ lɛne noo, wu bânɛ wumu, wu koŋe wumu, kɛnɛ wu yuge wumu le chuule wu jode wumu fɛkuu. Gɛ taŋlo bɛŋ lɛ̂ne Nyo le bɛŋ ka lɛne bige le gɛ.

Noo, njɛme bɛŋ le lɛ keefɛ bɛŋ lûume kune kinche kena le laa bɛŋ lé bɛŋ jî la lɛ, kɛnɛ bɛŋ mu la lɛ, kɛnɛ kune ye yene laa bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ jii la lɛ. Gɛ kiyo ki muh fede mwɛɛ munjile gɛ? Gɛ ye yi muh fede tɛ njú gɛ?
Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ no munyii mù fuune we le. Gɛ mu to mu boone gɛ, kɛnɛ mu gweji ŋgu mu banyi mu gɛɛde a basaŋkwa le gɛ. Geenɛ, Chiji wene wù le fɛwe nyaŋe gɛh mu. Gɛ bɛŋ yage munyii gɛ?
Le yɛɛŋ a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ wù fuuŋse, wù taŋlo wu bisɛ gɛh kife shige yi kinche ke le?
Bɛŋ luume kune njú nje la? Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ no nfudɛ kuu kwa wù nyu. Gɛ nfudɛ to wu lɛne gɛ kɛnɛ wu shiŋe njú gɛ.
Geenɛ, nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ gɛh Nfoŋ Salamoŋ bɛ bvukugɛ bvuchii bvù wu gɛ̀ kɛme gɛ̀ susɛ ye wu bu fɛ nfudɛ wumu le gɛ.
Nyo nɛ suse agaaŋ a nchvuuŋ nɛ, agaaŋ a kuu abɛŋ, bu antaana ba fwɛɛ lo fɛtaŋ, tu gɛ taŋlo wu susɛ bɛŋ wu fe lo noo gɛ? O oo bamii ba mbɛmɛ wù shige!
Noo, keefɛ fi fûuŋse bɛŋ, bɛŋ dûu laa bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ ji la lɛ, bɛŋ mu la lɛ, kɛnɛ lɛ bɛŋ jii la ye le lɛ.
Mwɛɛ munɛ munchii le mù bamii ba kee gɛ Nyo gɛ to bo gɛɛde bvufee yi mu le. Bɛŋ le fiena Chiji wene wù le fɛwe kee lɛ bɛŋ goone mwɛɛ munɛ munchii.
Bɛŋ ya bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛ bvufee bwena nyu yi bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le bɛ yi fiɛɛ fì le chaaŋ a wu jii le, wu mo wu nyaa tɛ mwɛɛ munɛ munchii bɛŋ le.
Fi mo fi nyu lɛ, keefɛ bɛŋ wɛ̂se kune fɛwɛge gɛ. Ba lé ba bû ba wɛse yi fiɛɛ fì fɛwɛge le, nyu fɛwɛge. Ŋgɛ wu yi juu le kooji gɛh yi juu chiyu chiɛɛ le.”

footnotes.text: Baŋwa bamu ba kege jɛme fɛnɛ lɛ, “Bvusɛ bee a kimbefɛ ntɛnɛɛ.”
